newsitem.title: FRANCE: Blast damages U.S. block at Paris university residence.
newsitem.headline: Blast damages U.S. block at Paris university residence.

text.p: A bomb exploded early on Monday outside the American block at the Cite Universitaire, the main hall of residence for Paris students, shattering windows and damaging three parked cars, police said.
There were no injuries and no one immediately claimed responsibility for the attack, in the south of the capital.
Police said the explosive device was packed into a small gas canister, denying reports that it was a 13-kilo (28 lb)canister.

They said there was no possible link between the blast and a gas canister bomb attack on a Paris commuter train which killed four people last December. The train attack, and a wave of bombings which killed eight people in 1995, have been blamed on Algerian Moslem fundamentalist rebels.
